dz: 七年战争：哈布斯堡奥地利军队在多姆施塔特战役中摧毁了一支普鲁士增援和补给车队，帮助将普鲁士国王腓特烈大帝驱逐出摩拉维亚。
de: Seven Years' War: Habsburg Austrian forces destroy a Prussian reinforcement and supply convoy in the Battle of Domstadtl, helping to expel Prussian King Frederick the Great from Moravia.

t: 一支荷兰部队与一支法国部队之间的埃克伦战役.
te: The Battle of Ekeren between a Dutch force and a French force.
dz: 一支荷兰部队与一支法国部队之间的埃克伦战役.
de: The Battle of Ekeren between a Dutch force and a French force.

t: 一支由戈德特·德·金克尔领导的威廉派军队在短暂的围攻后从雅各派手中夺取了阿特隆城.
te: A Williamite army under Godert de Ginkell takes the city of Athlone from the Jacobites after a short siege.
dz: 一支由戈德特·德·金克尔领导的威廉派军队在短暂的围攻后从雅各派手中夺取了阿特隆城.
de: A Williamite army under Godert de Ginkell takes the city of Athlone from the Jacobites after a short siege.

t: 不朽七人向威廉发出邀请，这将在光荣革命中达到顶峰。
te: The Immortal Seven issue the Invitation to William, which would culminate in the Glorious Revolution.
dz: 不朽七人向威廉发出邀请，这将在光荣革命中达到顶峰。
de: The Immortal Seven issue the Invitation to William, which would culminate in the Glorious Revolution.

t: 克梅尔尼茨基起义:贝雷斯特克之战以波兰的胜利告终.
te: Khmelnytsky Uprising: The Battle of Berestechko ends with a Polish victory.
dz: 德鲁日:克梅尔尼茨基起义:贝雷斯特克之战以波兰的胜利告终.
de: The Deluge: Khmelnytsky Uprising: The Battle of Berestechko ends with a Polish victory.

t: 效忠于国王查理一世的皇家主义者由纽卡斯尔伯爵率领,在阿德瓦尔顿·摩尔之战中击败了费尔法克斯勋爵…
te: Royalists loyal to King Charles I led by the Earl of Newcastle defeat Parliamentarian troops commanded by Lord Fairfax …
dz: 效忠于国王查理一世的皇家主义者由纽卡斯尔伯爵率领,在阿德瓦尔顿·摩尔之战中击败了费尔法克斯勋爵所指挥的议会派军队,让他们能攻克布拉德福德和利兹.
de: Royalists loyal to King Charles I led by the Earl of Newcastle defeat Parliamentarian troops commanded by Lord Fairfax in the battle of Adwalton Moor, allowing them to capture Bradford and Leeds.

t: 塔尔图大学成立.
te: The University of Tartu is founded.
dz: 塔尔图大学成立.
de: The University of Tartu is founded.

t: 西班牙控制的波多黎各圣胡安的Castillo San Felipe del Morro被围困了…
te: The Spanish-held Castillo San Felipe del Morro in San Juan, Puerto Rico having been besieged for fifteen days, surrende…
dz: 西班牙控制的波多黎各圣胡安的Castillo San Felipe del Morro被围困了15天,向由Cumberland Earl George Clifford爵士领导的英国部队投降.
de: The Spanish-held Castillo San Felipe del Morro in San Juan, Puerto Rico having been besieged for fifteen days, surrenders to an English force under Sir George Clifford, Earl of Cumberland.

t: 法国国王亨利二世在对阵蒙哥马利伯爵加布里埃尔·德·洛尔热斯的比赛中受了致命伤.
te: King Henry II of France is mortally wounded in a jousting match against Gabriel de Lorges, Count of Montgomery.
dz: 法国国王亨利二世在对阵蒙哥马利伯爵加布里埃尔·德·洛尔热斯的比赛中受了致命伤.
de: King Henry II of France is mortally wounded in a jousting match against Gabriel de Lorges, Count of Montgomery.

t: 西班牙军队在西班牙征服伊比利亚-纳瓦雷时,在诺安战役中击败了一支法国和纳瓦雷塞联合军队.
te: Spanish forces defeat a combined French and Navarrese army at the Battle of Noáin during the Spanish conquest of Iberia…
dz: 西班牙军队在西班牙征服伊比利亚-纳瓦雷时,在诺安战役中击败了一支法国和纳瓦雷塞联合军队.
de: Spanish forces defeat a combined French and Navarrese army at the Battle of Noáin during the Spanish conquest of Iberian Navarre.

t: 米兰公爵与瑞士各州之间的阿贝多战役.
te: Battle of Arbedo between the duke of Milan and the Swiss cantons.
dz: 米兰公爵与瑞士各州之间的阿贝多战役.
de: Battle of Arbedo between the duke of Milan and the Swiss cantons.

t: 明朝朱允炆即位，是为建文帝。
te: Zhu Yunwen ascended the throne to the Ming dynasty to become the Jianwen Emperor.
dz: 明朝朱允炆即位，是为建文帝。
de: Zhu Yunwen ascended the throne to the Ming dynasty to become the Jianwen Emperor.

t: 皇帝君士坦丁五世的拜占庭军队在安契亚卢斯战役中击败了保加利亚军队.
te: The Byzantine army of emperor Constantine V defeats the Bulgarian forces in the Battle of Anchialus.
dz: 皇帝君士坦丁五世的拜占庭军队在安契亚卢斯战役中击败了保加利亚军队.
de: The Byzantine army of emperor Constantine V defeats the Bulgarian forces in the Battle of Anchialus.

t: 教宗马塞利努斯开始他的教宗.
te: Pope Marcellinus begins his papacy.
dz: 教宗马塞利努斯开始他的教宗.
de: Pope Marcellinus begins his papacy.
